subject: [PATCH v2 1/8] NFSD: validate transport name in listener_set before serv creation

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch validates the transport name in the listener_set function before server creation to prevent a user-mode helper upcall from running under nfsd_mutex. The validation checks if the transport name is one of the supported classes (tcp, udp, or rdma) and ensures that an unknown name does not trigger a request_module call. This narrows the scope of the upcall rather than removing it entirely, allowing for autoloading in modular cases.
